title: Punch correction approvals
hint: Correction requests from workers. Tap one to check the request and that day's punches, then approve or reject.
empty: No punch corrections waiting for approval.
applyNote: Approving rewrites the punch to this (the original punch is kept on record).
mine: You can't approve your own request. Ask another approver.
rejectHint: If rejected, the punch stays as it is. The worker can see the result on the punch screen.

err.APPROVE_FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to approve.
err.SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN: You can't approve your own request. Ask another approver.
err.not_found: This request was not found (it may have been withdrawn).
err.log_not_found: The punch to correct was not found.
err.other: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
